consequence.statement: The new field is optional and can be adopted by users configuring Azure DNS solvers with managed identity authentication; existing configurations without this field continue to work.

original.statement: A new optional field spec.acme.solvers[].dns01.azureDNS.managedIdentity.tenantID was added to the Issuer v1 schema.

decision.reason: The computed CRD diff between [ev-84061d76ea1b] (v1.16.0) and [ev-60054fcf0986] (v1.17.0) only adds the path spec.acme.solvers[].dns01.azureDNS.managedIdentity.tenantID to the Issuer v1 schema. The canonical validator confirmed added→none for this change. Nothing in the evidence says anything fails, is rejected, is no longer honoured or must be migrated, so consequence kind none (informational) is supported. Confidence is low because the excerpts shown don't directly show that the field is optional.
